notes.title: Blaster Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Graphic Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add the option to change the quality of the game. Automatically set the quality of the game to the best quality for the device.
[*]Introduce upscaling modes to the game, such as DLSS or Image Scaling.
[*]Implement Frame Generation for enhanced performance.
[/list]

[h2]Language[/h2]
Add new languages to the game:
[list]
[*]Deutsch
[*]Greek
[*]Spanish
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Thai
[*]Ukrainian
[*]Vietnamese
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add full controller support for the game.
[*]Fix minor issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 03 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes Description:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players were unable to reload a weapon that had been dropped.
[*] Added the ability to adjust mouse sensitivity.
[*] Added the ability to adjust aiming sensitivity.
[*] Introduced controller support for character movement.
[/list]
